description: Welcome to this inviting 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, offering privacy, scenic hill views, and a desirable location just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, and freeway access.  Fresh landscaping and recently painted interior, along with refreshed exterior paint on the front of the home, create wonderful curb appeal and a move-in-ready feel.
